steps: On Android, open the Play Store and install 'Google Opinion Rewards' by Google LLC; on iPhone, install it from the App Store.
Open the app and sign in with your Google account (on iOS, connect your PayPal account during setup).
Answer the initial profile questions about yourself (age, gender, location, interests) so surveys can be matched to you.
Turn on notifications — surveys arrive about once a week and can expire quickly.
When a survey notification arrives, open it and answer the questions honestly (most take 10-30 seconds).
Your credit (up to $1.00 per survey) is added to your Play balance on Android, or accumulates toward PayPal payout on iOS.
On Android, spend the credit in the Play Store — it applies automatically at checkout for apps, games, movies, or subscriptions.
timing: Credit is added on survey completion; there is no separate payout schedule.
